clauses.clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control six or more lands, create a 5/5 red Dragon creature token with flying.

mapping.notes: Your-upkeep TurnPhaseEvent; the intervening 'if' is the condition (Fabled Passage's comparison over number_you_control(...) lands, 6); a 5/5 red flying Dragon TokenSpec. packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: dragonmaster_outcast_your_upkeep_makes_it, dragonmaster_outcast_six_lands_make_a_dragon, dragonmaster_outcast_five_lands_make_nothing. Ontology round R12: the tree translated into the one comparison (same meaning), the draft, clauses and notes reworded.
